SELECT * FROM EDS.DATE_DIM WHERE FULLDATE like '%2024%' and month_end='Y'

select
			(DATEDIFF(DAY, GREATEST('2024-01-26',DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, '2024-01-29'), 0)), '2024-01-29')-1) WH_DAY_DIFF_MONTH  
            ,(DATEDIFF(DAY, GREATEST('2024-11-29',DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, '2024-12-02'), 0)), '2024-12-02')-1) WH_DAY_DIFF_MONTH2     
			,(DATEDIFF(DAY, GREATEST('2024-01-26',DATEADD(YEAR, DATEDIFF(YEAR, 0, '2024-01-29'), 0)), '2024-01-29')-1) WH_DAY_DIFF_YEAR
			,DATEDIFF(day, '2024-12-02', '2024-12-31') MONTH_END_DIFF
